candidates.name: OS Net positioning data
verified_facts: OS Net is Great Britain's active national GNSS reference network, using around 120 continuously operating base stations.
It supports real-time and post-processed high-accuracy positioning tied to the national coordinate reference system.
OS Net observation data includes RINEX availability for precision post-processing.
semantic_limits: Centimetre-level positioning capability is conditional on observation and processing quality and cannot be assigned directly to parcel LiDAR height differences or used to erase raster/sensor uncertainty.

candidates.name: OS legacy control data
verified_facts: OS groups passive GPS stations, benchmarks and triangulation stations as legacy control information.
These legacy datasets are no longer maintained as the current national positioning infrastructure.
Current geodetic positioning is provided through OS Net and modern transformation resources rather than silently reusing archive control.
semantic_limits: Legacy control remains useful historical/reference evidence but cannot override current OS Net/OSTN15/OSGM15 lineage or serve as a fresh parcel elevation observation.
